countries.reasoning: China is the world's largest carbon producer, dominating global output per recent industry reports and USGS data from 2023. Production data is reliable and consistent.
India is a major carbon producer with substantial industrial activity. Data from 2022-2023 industry surveys supports this estimate.
The U.S. has significant carbon production mainly from synthetic graphite and other carbon materials, well documented by USGS and trade statistics.
Russia produces a sizeable quantity of carbon, mainly through mining and synthetic production; data from national agencies roughly supports this figure.
Brazil contributes moderately to global carbon production, mainly via natural graphite; data is less frequent but supported by South American mining statistics.
